name.text: The Ferris wheel (angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference)

questiontext.text:
A Ferris wheel has its centre at \(O\). Two cabins, \(A\) and \(B\), are on the rim of the wheel. A rider at point \(C\) on the rim sees the two cabins, and angle \(ACB = {@c@}^\circ\). The arms \(OA\) and \(OB\) are equal in length.

[[jsxgraph width="380px" height="400px"]] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, {boundingbox:[-1.6,1.6,1.6,-1.8], axis:false, showCopyright:false, showNavigation:false, keepAspectRatio:true}); var r = Math.PI/180; var c = {#c#}, cc = {#cc#}; function pt(nm, deg, col) { var t = deg*r; return board.create('point',[Math.cos(t),Math.sin(t)],{name:nm,fixed:true,size:5,strokeColor:col,fillColor:col, label:{offset:[16*Math.cos(t)-4,16*Math.sin(t)-4],strokeColor:col}}); } // ground and stand board.create('segment',[[-1.4,-1.6],[1.4,-1.6]],{fixed:true,strokeColor:'#16a34a',strokeWidth:8,highlight:false}); board.create('segment',[[-0.7,-1.6],[0,0]],{fixed:true,strokeColor:'#92400e',strokeWidth:5,highlight:false}); board.create('segment',[[0.7,-1.6],[0,0]],{fixed:true,strokeColor:'#92400e',strokeWidth:5,highlight:false}); // wheel board.create('circle',[[0,0],1],{fixed:true,strokeColor:'#1d4ed8',strokeWidth:4,fillColor:'#bfdbfe',fillOpacity:0.5,highlight:false}); var O = board.create('point',[0,0],{name:'O',fixed:true,size:4,strokeColor:'#1e293b',fillColor:'#1e293b',label:{offset:[8,-16]}}); var A = pt('A', 90+c, '#dc2626'); var B = pt('B', 90-c, '#dc2626'); var C = pt('C', cc, '#16a34a'); board.create('segment',[O,A],{fixed:true,strokeColor:'#dc2626',strokeWidth:3}); board.create('segment',[O,B],{fixed:true,strokeColor:'#dc2626',strokeWidth:3}); board.create('segment',[C,A],{fixed:true,strokeColor:'#ea580c',strokeWidth:3}); board.create('segment',[C,B],{fixed:true,strokeColor:'#ea580c',strokeWidth:3}); board.create('segment',[A,B],{fixed:true,strokeColor:'#7c3aed',strokeWidth:2,dash:2}); board.create('angle',[B,C,A],{radius:0.3,fillColor:'#facc15',fillOpacity:0.8,strokeColor:'#ca8a04',withLabel:false}); board.create('angle',[B,O,A],{radius:0.3,fillColor:'#fca5a5',fillOpacity:0.8,strokeColor:'#dc2626',withLabel:false}); [[/jsxgraph]]

(a) Find angle \(AOB\). [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]

[[feedback:prt1]]

(b) Find angle \(OAB\). [[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]]

[[feedback:prt2]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

(a) The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference when both stand on the same arc: \(AOB = 2 \times {@c@} = {@ta1@}^\circ\).

(b) \(OA = OB\) because they are radii, so triangle \(OAB\) is isosceles with equal base angles: \(OAB = (180 - {@ta1@}) \div 2 = {@ta2@}^\circ\).
